examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Three success stories in equal columns, each mark on its client brand colour, read from the client registry by name, with the story line beneath. Hover a column to reveal its link line; edit the cells in the Controls panel — a band with no cells renders nothing at all.

examples.name: Reveal on hover
examples.summary: Three client cards painted in each client's colours. Hover or focus a card on a wide canvas to open it: the logo rises and the story line and Read story cue slide in. On narrow canvases every card is open.
